messages:
Alex: FYI a few customers reported surprising behavior when server auto-splits: SDKs retried and ended up duplicating requests. We need a clearer client/server contract.
Priya: Agreed. Short term: add X-Embed-Split-Id in auto-split responses so SDKs can detect server-split vs client-split and avoid duplicate retries.
Nikhil: Also add X-Embed-Units-Estimate header in 413/preview responses so SDKs can decide to split client-side before retrying. Keep estimate conservative.
Jess: Console UX: show a per-tenant "Recent Splits" list with split_id, original_size, subrequest_count, and an anonymized sample to help integrators. Include a toggle to auto-apply server-splits.
Clara: Telemetry: embed_split.requested, embed_split.applied(server|client), embed_split.duplicate_retry_detected. Tag with tenant, sdk_name, split_id, estimate_units.
Alex: API contract proposal: when server auto-splits, respond 200 with body {"split_id":"s-...","subrequests":N} and header X-Embed-Split-Id:s-... SDKs treat that as success and do not resend originals. If split fails, 500 with split_id and retry guidance.
Priya: For advisory flows (preview/estimate), return 200 with X-Embed-Units-Estimate and optional JSON: {"suggested_ranges":[[0,1500],[1500,3000]],"pressure_score":42}. Keep this path lightweight (no full parse).
Nikhil: SDK changes: on 413, call preview once; if preview returns suggested_ranges, prefer client-split; if preview returns only estimate but no safe ranges, show a single retry which asks user to split. Also honor header X-Embed-Accept-Server-Split to let tenants opt in.
Jess: Rollout plan: feature-flag server-split with 1% canary. Console shows canary tag. Telemetry dashboards: split_success_rate, duplicate_retry_rate, preview_latency_ms, preview_cache_hit_ratio.
Clara: Security note: preview/estimate endpoints must never log or persist raw vectors. Only aggregates (counts, dims, sizes). Add a guard in the parser that scrubs buffers before any logging path.
Alex: Billing semantics: units charged = actual embeddings produced. But quota checks use conservative estimate so customers can't sneak under quota. Document that clearly in pricing docs.
Priya: Edge-case: mixed dims within a single batch. Preview should detect and return explain:["mixed_dims"] with per-range dims where possible, otherwise reject with 422 and include a short sample curl showing how to split client-side.
Nikhil: Performance: preview path should run in <1ms median. Use Content-Length + X-Embed-Dims hint + small peek instead of full JSON parsing. Cache by (tenant,dims_hint,avg_bytes) TTL 5m.
Jess: Ops: new alert - page eng-sre if duplicate_retry_rate > 0.2% over 10m or preview_error_rate > 0.3% over 5m.
OpsBot: Alert created: duplicate_retry_rate > 0.2% over 10m on /v1/embeddings -> paging eng-sre. Alert created: preview_error_rate > 0.3% over 5m on /v1/embeddings -> paging eng-sre.
Clara: Next actions: Alex will draft API wording and example responses, Priya will add headers to preview RFC, Nikhil will prototype SDK de-dup logic, Jess will wire Console list + telemetry widgets. Sync in the eng-platform standup tomorrow. :thumbsup:
